categories.title: Face
categories.blurb: Device-assisted facials and lifting work, tuned to your skin type.

items.name: Microcurrent therapy
items.description: Gentle low-level currents lift and tone facial muscles, ease swelling and restore expression — a favourite after a tiring week.

items.name: RF lifting
items.description: Radiofrequency waves firm the skin from within, soften fine lines and improve laxity — without needles or downtime.

items.name: Lifting facial massage
items.description: A face, neck and scalp massage that relaxes muscles, refines your contour and reduces puffiness, finished with device-assisted skincare.

items.name: Facial carboxytherapy
items.description: A dedicated device treatment that evens out tone, boosts firmness and strengthens skin's own defences. Comfortable, with visible results from the first session.

items.name: Signature Ritual facial
items.description: A deep cleanse tailored to your skin, with extraction, exfoliation and a calming mask, leaving your face clear, smooth and glowing.

categories.title: Body
categories.blurb: Lymphatic drainage and relaxing bodywork by hands with decades of practice.

items.name: Pressotherapy suit + facial
items.description: Full-body relaxation in a pressotherapy suit that supports lymphatic drainage, while our cosmetologist cares for your face. Two rituals, one hour.

items.name: Pressotherapy drainage
items.description: Slow, rhythmic drainage that moves fluid retention, eases heavy legs and leaves your whole body feeling lighter — soothing after travel.

items.name: Full-body relaxing massage
items.description: An unhurried full-body massage by hands with decades of practice — tension eases, breathing slows, and the week finally lets go.

items.name: Back & shoulders massage
items.description: Targeted work on the back, neck and shoulders where the day collects — perfect between long hours at a desk.

categories.title: Nails
categories.blurb: Careful hand and foot care with kind, long-wearing finishes.

items.name: Classic manicure
items.description: Nail shaping, cuticle care and a polish of your choice — neat, precise, unhurried.

items.name: Gel manicure
items.description: A hand massage and hydrating mask before a long-lasting gel finish that keeps its shine for weeks.

items.name: Spa pedicure
items.description: A softening treatment and foot massage alongside full nail care — the ritual your feet remember.

items.name: Nail art (per design)
items.description: A finishing touch — from a classic French tip to a delicate design, added onto any manicure.

items.name: Body pressotherapy suit while facial treatment
items.description: A session of complete relaxation that works on the whole body and the face at once. A specialised suit delivers a lymphatic drainage massage while our cosmetologist treats your face skin according to its type and its needs.

items.name: Microcurrent therapy
items.description: Microcurrent therapy on premium-class equipment reduces swelling quickly and painlessly, restores muscle mobility, eases spasms, aids tissue recovery after surgery and improves skin tone — so you look better and younger without aggressive procedures. It also helps restore facial expression after unsuccessful Botox injections.

items.name: RF lifting
items.description: Improves the tone and turgor of the skin, evens out your complexion and softens the appearance of wrinkles. Works well against skin laxity. Premium equipment.

items.name: Lifting facial massage
items.description: A massage of the face, neck and scalp using adaptive techniques that restore muscle mobility and tone, refine the contour of the face and reduce puffiness. Includes facial care with device-assisted methods and cosmetic products. Lasts one hour.

items.name: Facial carboxytherapy
items.description: Carried out with a dedicated device and cosmetics, this treatment is a pleasure to receive and gives striking results. It evens out tone and complexion, improves the quality and firmness of the skin, and strengthens the skin's own natural defences.

staff.name: Alena
staff.description: Helps preserve youth and natural beauty without radical treatments. Thanks to a personalized approach and professional techniques, skin tone is improved, puffiness is reduced, facial muscles are relaxed, and contours are defined. Each treatment combines care, aesthetics, and visible results.

staff.name: Margarita
staff.description: Helps relieve muscle tension, restore strength, and improve well-being. Professional techniques promote relaxation, improve circulation, and restore lightness to the body. Each treatment is tailored to your needs, ensuring you feel comfortable and notice results after just one session.

aboutCosmetics.title: The brands we trust
aboutCosmetics.subtitle: Every product on our table is chosen by hand — cold-pressed, fragrance-honest and kind to reactive skin.
